---
title: "A page image Quarto cannot measure gets no size"
image: square.svg
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image:height"'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width"'
---

The size the site declares for its own image does not describe this page's image.
